blocks.text: This report covers user growth and engagement for the product over the last five months. Monthly active users have grown steadily, with the largest jump occurring between March and April following the release of the mobile app redesign.

Figure 1: Active users by month, in thousands
Jan 120
Feb 150
Mar 135
Apr 180
May 210
Figure 1: Active users by month, in thousands
Retention also improved during this period, with week-4 retention rising from 38% in January to 47% in May.
